app_tagline: Mobile money cash points near you
saved_empty_body: Open a cash point on the map and tap Save to find it here quickly.
update_available: A new version of Daily is available.
auth_mode_label: Sign in or create an account
auth_password_hint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth_error_email_taken: An account already exists with this email. Sign in instead.
auth_error_weak_password: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.
auth_error_password_too_long: This password is too long (72 characters maximum).
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth_error_signup_disabled: New accounts are paused. Try again later.
auth_error_offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.
auth_error_confirmation_pending: This account still needs email confirmation, which Daily does not use. Please contact support.
onboarding_nearby_body: Daily shows mobile money agents (MTN MoMo and Orange Money) around you. Points appear on the map as people withdraw there.
onboarding_location_body: Daily uses your location only while the app is open: to show the nearest points and to place a new point when you withdraw. Other users never see who withdrew.
onboarding_location_denied: Location is off. You can still use the map and turn it on later in your browser settings.
onboarding_pin_body: Daily never asks for, sees or stores your PIN. You type it in your phone's dialer, as in any normal withdrawal.
privacy_intro: Daily helps you find mobile money agents and withdraw faster. This is what happens with your data.
privacy_collect_body: Your email and password (to sign in), your settings, and for each withdrawal you start in Daily: the network, the agent code, the amount, the place and the time. Only you can see your withdrawals.
privacy_public_body: Cash points: network, agent code, location and how often they are used. A point is never linked to the people who withdrew there.
privacy_location_body: Used only while Daily is open, to show nearby points and to place a point when you withdraw. Daily never tracks you in the background.
privacy_pin_body: Daily never asks for, sees, sends or stores your PIN or any payment secret. You type your PIN in your phone's dialer.
privacy_delete_body: You can delete your account at any time in Profile. This removes your account, your withdrawals and your saved points. Points on the map stay, without any link to you.
location_denied: Location is off. Turn it on in your browser settings to see points near you.
location_unsupported: This browser can't share your location.
nearby_empty: No points here yet. When someone withdraws at an agent, the point appears on the map.
withdraw_copied: Copied. Paste it in your Phone app to dial.
withdraw_pin_hint: Your phone's dialer opens. Check the details, then type your PIN there. Daily never sees it.
withdraw_no_template: Dialing isn't set up for this network yet. Connect to the internet and try again.
withdraw_no_location: Location is off, so this agent won't be added to the map. You can still dial.
notice_point_created: New cash point added to the map. Thank you!
notice_rejected_location_inaccurate: Your location wasn't precise enough to add this agent to the map.
notice_rejected_outside_service_area: This place is outside Cameroon, so the agent wasn't added to the map.
notice_rejected_daily_point_limit: You've added the most new points allowed today, so this agent wasn't added.
notice_rejected_too_close: You already added a point for this network right here today.
notice_rejected_daily_withdrawal_limit: You've reached today's limit of recorded withdrawals.
notice_rejected_impossible_jump: Your position changed too quickly, so this withdrawal wasn't recorded.
notice_rejected_location_required: Location was off, so this agent wasn't added to the map.
notice_rejected_point_gone: This cash point is no longer available.
notice_saved_failed: Your saved points couldn't be updated.
profile_sign_out_pending: Some withdrawals or saved points haven't reached the server yet ({count}). Signing out now discards them. Connect to the internet first to keep them.
profile_delete_body: This permanently deletes your account, your withdrawals and your saved points. Points on the map stay, without any link to you.
profile_delete_offline: Connect to the internet to delete your account.
profile_delete_failed: We couldn't delete your account. Try again.
